QuestInfo.name: Carta's sin
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2081000##k from #b#m240000000##k village says he has some information for me...
QuestInfo.1: I learned that Humans used to have strong will power to resist temptation, which prevented them from getting seduced by the monsters. But, #bwitch #p2060100##k took away the people's will power and since then, humans have been falling into seduction.  I wonder if this is really true.  Let's go ask #p2060100#.

0.0: You look like the strongest among human beings. Without a #bstrong will#k, it's impossible to be that powerful. Do you know fairies and herrings are not temped? Quite unlike humans.
0.1: Humans used to be like that. Magic of temptation, when used by monsters, work for monsters but not for those with pure will. Somebody ruined it. Do you know #bwitch #p2060100##k?
0.2: Destroying willpower is among #p2060100#'s many sins. She took all of the #bpower to resist temptation#k. Her hatred towards humanity made her sin.
0.3: You don't seem to believe it. Your experience will tell you everything. Were you ever tempted by a monster and couldn't control yourself? Exactly. That's the result of #b#p2060100#'s curse#k.
0.4: A will to resist temptation. It's hard to make it no matter how hard you train yourself because #p2060100# took it away. If you want it back, go to see #p2060100#. If you lose your mind, the whole world will be threatened. Please find your #bwill#k.

yes.0: #p2060100# is studying magic somewhere in the deep sea. She won't give what you seek easily.

no.0: If you don't want to, then that's fine. Humans may not deserve to get their will back..

1.0: You came here deep in the sea. It must be urgent. What's the matter? I don't like anyone strong like you.

npc.0: #b#p2060100##k is not willing to give the will.
